name: Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered
detailed_description:
The first installment of the Lloyd the Monkey trilogy has arrived on Steam in a remastered form, rebuilt from the ground up to create the ideal version of the classic platformer!

Centuries have passed since the new millennium, and not only has humanity taken to the stars, but our closest relatives have evolved to match us and have created a society all their own in the Amazon jungle, a paradise where nature and technology blend in harmony.

But destiny dictates that life never stays the same for very long, as a mysterious, bushy-tailed girl has fallen from the sky and, with nowhere else to go, has taken up residence with the Zaru brothers Lloyd and Arnie. Unbeknownst to all, this girl’s presence has attracted the attention of a seedy group of gorillas who have claimed land still poisoned by the sins of the past as their base. For there is a secret hidden from all parties that will soon change the lives of everyone who gets tangled up in it. The Lloyd the Monkey saga is about to begin!

Features:

  • All twelve stages from the HMTL5 version, combined into six maps.

  • Classical music complementing the original score.

  • Retro aesthetics invoking the 16-bit classics.

  • Polygonal 3D Special Stages.
